ns2:course.label: Off-Campus Study
ns2:course.description: (LEIST 299) Provides campus credit for foreign or domestic study completed off-campus. A student's proposal for study must have prior approval of the major department and the college office. Final determination of appropriate credit is made on the student's completion of the work. May be repeated to a maximum of 32 hours. (summer session, 0 to 8 undergraduate hours). Prerequisite: Advanced standing and approval of major department and college.
